title: The Hundred: A Nouns Casting Call
creator: Michael Hoydich

source.customization: New deterministic combinations of canonical traits; no newly drawn trait assets
source.identity_note: 100 original-framework combinations of canonical Nouns traits. Local fictional characters; not minted token identities, ownership or rarity claims.

seed_algorithm: sha256-series-v1 for background/body/accessory/glasses; curated canonical head per roster

cohorts.name: Screen After Dark
cohorts.description: A midnight film society with a different way of seeing.

cohorts.name: Signal Garage
cohorts.description: Helpful machines learning the art of being off duty.

cohorts.name: Deep Time Radio
cohorts.description: A station broadcasting the music between the decades.

cohorts.name: Tidal Department
cohorts.description: A seaside crew collecting stories instead of trophies.

cohorts.name: Pocket Cosmos
cohorts.description: Big cosmic questions from a very small observatory.

cohorts.name: Night Market
cohorts.description: The last food stalls in town and the first place you belong.

cohorts.name: Greenroom Garden
cohorts.description: A slow-growing ensemble for everyday wonder.

cohorts.name: Field Trip Club
cohorts.description: Local explorers who find a new world one block away.

cohorts.name: Paper City
cohorts.description: The keepers of small fortunes, notes and neighborhood promises.

cohorts.name: Oddball League
cohorts.description: A sporting club where the best move is welcoming someone in.

items.name: Cam
items.oneLiner: Finds the shot everyone else walks past.
items.bio: The club's tiny documentary director records the moments before anyone says action. Cam is making a film about an empty chair and has already found three endings.

items.name: Grain
items.oneLiner: Keeps beautiful imperfections in the picture.
items.bio: A patient film archivist with a soft spot for scratched prints and unfinished thoughts. Grain believes every accident deserves one screening before it is called a mistake.

items.name: Splice
items.oneLiner: Connects two ordinary moments into a surprising story.
items.bio: The neighborhood editor can turn a bus ride into a cliffhanger. Splice's secret project is a trailer for a day when absolutely nothing happens.

items.name: Blue Hour
items.oneLiner: Turns a small technical failure into a new beginning.
items.bio: Once a projection booth monitor, Blue Hour now hosts screenings during the nightly reboot. Their audience has learned that a blank screen can also be an invitation.

items.name: Scout
items.oneLiner: Finds a location with room for another story.
items.bio: This location scout photographs doorways, rooftops and forgotten corners. Scout wants the next blockbuster to happen within walking distance of home.

items.name: Wide Eyes
items.oneLiner: Makes every seat feel like the front row.
items.bio: The club's welcoming host remembers what each guest loves about movies. Wide Eyes thinks the best special effect is someone saving you a seat.

items.name: Double
items.oneLiner: Helps a character see another side of themselves.
items.bio: A reflective acting coach who always offers a second reading. Double's workshop begins with a simple question: what happens when the understudy gets the scene?

items.name: Index
items.oneLiner: Remembers the tiny detail that makes the whole story click.
items.bio: A script supervisor who carries more questions than corrections. Index is building a catalogue of every time a background extra changed the movie.

items.name: Twinkle
items.oneLiner: Gives the quietest performer a moment in the light.
items.bio: An aspiring lighting designer with an extravagant imagination and one reliable lamp. Twinkle can make a laundromat feel like opening night.

items.name: Ghostlight
items.oneLiner: Keeps the theatre welcoming after the audience goes home.
items.bio: The club's gentle night custodian hears stories in every creaking floorboard. Ghostlight leaves one light on for the show that has not found its cast yet.

items.name: Servo
items.oneLiner: Helps a useful machine discover an unnecessary hobby.
items.bio: A workshop assistant who is very good at finishing tasks and very new to stopping. Servo has started building tiny sculptures from the leftover minutes.

items.name: Trace
items.oneLiner: Follows a complicated problem back to one clear connection.
items.bio: The garage's circuit cartographer loves untangling messy systems. Trace spends weekends drawing maps of friendships that would never fit on a board.

items.name: Turing Jr
items.oneLiner: Asks a better question before choosing an answer.
items.bio: An inquisitive logic enthusiast who hosts impossible-question night. Turing Jr is especially interested in why jokes work and why explaining them usually does not.

items.name: Tab
items.oneLiner: Keeps the right idea open until you are ready for it.
items.bio: A gentle workspace companion with a collection of half-finished projects. Tab is learning to close a window without calling the view a failure.

items.name: Socket
items.oneLiner: Finds a place for the disconnected to plug in.
items.bio: The unofficial host of the repair table makes room for one more lamp, one more visitor and one more story. Socket's own favourite possession runs on no power at all.

items.name: Faxwell
items.oneLiner: Delivers slow messages with unexpectedly perfect timing.
items.bio: A retired office machine with a second career in neighborhood correspondence. Faxwell sends invitations one page at a time and calls the waiting part suspense.

items.name: Relay
items.oneLiner: Connects distant friends without stealing the spotlight.
items.bio: A rooftop signal watcher who thinks distance should make a story richer. Relay dreams of broadcasting a lullaby that arrives just as every listener needs it.

items.name: Ringback
items.oneLiner: Knows when a conversation deserves another try.
items.bio: The garage's call-back coordinator never confuses silence with disinterest. Ringback writes little reminders to return not just calls, but kindness.

items.name: Sum
items.oneLiner: Makes a complicated plan feel countable.
items.bio: A practical estimator with a highly impractical collection of rubber ducks. Sum measures success by how many people can understand the plan after lunch.

items.name: Second
items.oneLiner: Protects the little pause between one thing and the next.
items.bio: An exacting timekeeper slowly becoming a fan of long afternoons. Second is trying to invent a clock that tells you when to stop checking the clock.

items.name: Boom
items.oneLiner: Starts the room moving before anyone feels ready.
items.bio: The station's portable party host can make a soundcheck into a celebration. Boom's most popular broadcast is a mixtape made entirely of neighborhood noises.

items.name: Side B
items.oneLiner: Finds the overlooked track worth coming back for.
items.bio: A late-night selector who always flips the tape. Side B collects stories about songs that were never hits but still changed someone's life.

items.name: Skip
items.oneLiner: Turns a repeated mistake into the hook.
items.bio: An experimental DJ who hears rhythm where other people hear a glitch. Skip is writing a dance record for people who insist they cannot dance.

items.name: Ivory
items.oneLiner: Builds a melody with enough room for another player.
items.bio: The station pianist loves a duet more than a solo. Ivory leaves the last bar unfinished so a passerby can decide where the song goes.

items.name: Low Note
items.oneLiner: Gives a small idea a very big entrance.
items.bio: A brass enthusiast whose quiet speaking voice surprises everyone. Low Note's dream commission is a fanfare for the opening of a neighborhood book swap.

items.name: Drone
items.oneLiner: Holds the long note while the world changes around it.
items.bio: The ensemble's patient texture-maker can make one sustained sound feel like weather. Drone is assembling a soundtrack for a walk that takes all afternoon.

items.name: Mix
items.oneLiner: Brings different voices into a shared rhythm.
items.bio: A practical producer who keeps the studio kettle within reach. Mix thinks a good session ends with everybody wanting to come back.

items.name: Bellwether
items.oneLiner: Marks an occasion before it slips past unnoticed.
items.bio: The station announcer rings in the small milestones: a repaired bicycle, a first poem, a new neighbor. Bellwether wants to give ordinary Tuesdays their own opening ceremony.

items.name: Chatter
items.oneLiner: Finds a good story by leaving room for an answer.
items.bio: A community radio interviewer with a talent for comfortable pauses. Chatter's longest-running series asks strangers about the object they nearly threw away.

items.name: Lip Sync
items.oneLiner: Makes a familiar line feel wonderfully unfamiliar.
items.bio: A playful vocal performer who treats every chorus like a costume change. Lip Sync is rehearsing a musical in which all the songs are directions to the studio.

items.name: Goldie
items.oneLiner: Notices the bright little story beneath the surface.
items.bio: The harbor's postcard correspondent finds news in ripples and reflections. Goldie publishes a daily edition that is only three sentences long.

items.name: Grouper
items.oneLiner: Makes a collection feel like a community.
items.bio: A fishing-club organizer who is happier counting friends than catches. Grouper's famous tackle box is mostly full of spare snacks and borrowed stories.

items.name: Puff
items.oneLiner: Gives a shy idea a little more room.
items.bio: The crew's caution-minded scout checks the weather and then makes space for wonder. Puff is learning that feeling small and being brave can happen together.

items.name: Fin
items.oneLiner: Cuts through an overcomplicated adventure plan.
items.bio: A sharp-eyed route planner with an unexpectedly gentle manner. Fin's best expedition so far ended at a new bench just across the harbor.

items.name: Bela
items.oneLiner: Answers a long day with a calm, clear welcome.
items.bio: A cool-water storyteller who hosts the pier's evening listening circle. Bela remembers every visitor's favourite sound of the sea.

items.name: Ink
items.oneLiner: Draws a fresh route when the old one gets washed away.
items.bio: A nautical illustrator whose maps leave generous space for discoveries. Ink is working on an atlas of places that exist only at low tide.

items.name: Clawdia
items.oneLiner: Fixes the little thing that is stopping the whole voyage.
items.bio: The dockside repair expert carries a toolbox of odd shapes and excellent questions. Clawdia can mend a reel, a sign or the awkward beginning of a friendship.

items.name: Tack
items.oneLiner: Finds another angle when the wind changes.
items.bio: A patient sailing tutor who treats detours as part of the lesson. Tack keeps a logbook of all the times arriving late led somewhere better.

items.name: Swell
items.oneLiner: Brings a little momentum to a still afternoon.
items.bio: The surf report host is equally interested in calm days and big waves. Swell is starting a beach club where sitting and watching counts as full participation.

items.name: Captain Elsewhere
items.oneLiner: Invites you aboard a story before you know its destination.
items.bio: A cheerful expedition planner with an impressive collection of imaginary ports. The captain's real ambition is to turn the harbor's oldest boat into a traveling library.

items.name: Else
items.oneLiner: Makes space for the question that does not fit.
items.bio: The observatory's keeper of mysteries resists the urge to explain everything away. Else files unsolved questions under 'worth another evening.'

items.name: Terra Firma
items.oneLiner: Brings an enormous idea back to a place you can stand.
items.bio: A grounded cosmic cartographer who begins every expedition at the doorstep. Terra Firma believes looking after a small patch of home is also a planetary project.

items.name: Jove
items.oneLiner: Makes a grand entrance and then remembers everybody's name.
items.bio: The planetarium's exuberant master of ceremonies loves a large-scale demonstration. Jove is planning the smallest parade ever held in honor of something enormous.

items.name: Ringlet
items.oneLiner: Finds the repeating pattern that makes a story sing.
items.bio: An orbital choreographer who sees dance moves in diagrams. Ringlet's next show will be performed by friends walking around the same table at different speeds.

items.name: Visitor
items.oneLiner: Asks the ordinary questions everyone forgot to ask.
items.bio: A curious newcomer who treats the laundromat like an archaeological wonder. Visitor is writing a guide to Earth based entirely on overheard small talk.

items.name: Maybe
items.oneLiner: Keeps more than one possible future in view.
items.bio: A speculative storyteller who trades predictions for good questions. Maybe hosts a weekly salon where every guest invents a kinder ending to a familiar problem.

items.name: Prism
items.oneLiner: Finds the colour hiding inside a grey day.
items.bio: The observatory's light artist turns everyday reflections into installations. Prism's favourite studio equipment is a glass of water beside a window.

items.name: Nimbus
items.oneLiner: Gives a passing mood a shape you can talk about.
items.bio: A weather diarist with a particular love of indecisive skies. Nimbus is making a forecast for an imaginary town where all feelings are allowed to pass through.

items.name: Zig
items.oneLiner: Turns a sudden spark into something worth testing.
items.bio: The crew's energetic prototyper has more sketches than shelves. Zig is trying to build a machine that catches the idea you have halfway through a shower.

items.name: Ember
items.oneLiner: Keeps a big ambition warm while it takes its time.
items.bio: A patient geology guide who knows that slow change can still transform a landscape. Ember's personal project is a tiny model mountain built one grain at a time.

items.name: Patty
items.oneLiner: Builds a familiar favourite with one unexpected layer.
items.bio: The night market's diner host remembers the order but asks about the day. Patty wants to make the counter the most welcoming seat in town.

items.name: Loop
items.oneLiner: Finds a reason to celebrate the round trip.
items.bio: A doughnut cart proprietor who names each special after a local shortcut. Loop's best-selling creation is called 'We Took the Long Way Home.'

items.name: Nori
items.oneLiner: Wraps a small gesture with great care.
items.bio: A precise stall designer who believes presentation can be a form of hospitality. Nori folds every takeaway note like a tiny invitation to return.

items.name: Tangle
items.oneLiner: Turns a messy evening into a shared table.
items.bio: The noodle stall's exuberant storyteller never quite finishes one anecdote before beginning another. Tangle's regulars come for supper and stay to help find the ending.

items.name: Fold
items.oneLiner: Makes a little space carry a lot of joy.
items.bio: A portable-kitchen inventor who can set up a feast on a very small counter. Fold is developing a picnic kit that fits in an ordinary pocket.

items.name: Bean
items.oneLiner: Helps a good conversation begin at its own speed.
items.bio: The late coffee stand's thoughtful host knows when to chat and when to refill. Bean collects the names of projects first imagined over a paper cup.

items.name: Tempura
items.oneLiner: Gives an everyday ingredient its moment on stage.
items.bio: An inventive snack vendor who treats crispness like a percussion instrument. Tempura is collaborating with the radio crew on a lunch that comes with its own rhythm.

items.name: Bao
items.oneLiner: Keeps a warm place for someone running late.
items.bio: A soft-spoken baker whose stall becomes an unofficial meeting point. Bao always saves the corner table for the friend who said they might stop by.

items.name: Floss
items.oneLiner: Makes a fleeting delight feel like a proper occasion.
items.bio: A confectioner who designs clouds you can carry home. Floss wants to build a fairground that fits into a single street without losing its sense of wonder.

items.name: Vendetta
items.oneLiner: Surprises you with the thing you did not know you needed.
items.bio: An old vending machine reimagined as a keeper of tiny gifts. Vendetta dispenses blank postcards, conversation starters and the occasional excellent biscuit.

items.name: Bon
items.oneLiner: Helps a small project grow without rushing its shape.
items.bio: A meticulous miniature gardener with an unexpectedly broad view of the world. Bon hosts a workshop where tending one thing well is enough for the afternoon.

items.name: Firry
items.oneLiner: Offers a steady point in a changing landscape.
items.bio: The garden's year-round lookout keeps a chair ready for every season. Firry is making an almanac of what stays dependable when everything else is changing.

items.name: Bloom
items.oneLiner: Recognizes the moment an idea is ready to open.
items.bio: A flower curator with a gift for encouraging tentative beginnings. Bloom keeps a vase for the stems that do not fit anyone else's arrangement.

items.name: Myco
items.oneLiner: Finds the quiet network connecting separate lives.
items.bio: The community compost enthusiast is also its best introducer. Myco seems to know exactly which two strangers should share a workbench.

items.name: Briar
items.oneLiner: Protects a delicate idea while it learns to stand.
items.bio: A rose tender who believes boundaries can make room for generosity. Briar's garden has a gate that is easy to find and a bench just inside it.

items.name: Sage
items.oneLiner: Knows how to make a little resource go a long way.
items.bio: A dry-garden caretaker with an inventive approach to scarcity. Sage teaches workshops on making something beautiful from the parts that are already at hand.

items.name: Beet Poet
items.oneLiner: Turns an ordinary day into a line worth keeping.
items.bio: The allotment's resident spoken-word performer writes on the backs of seed packets. Beet Poet is preparing a recital about everything that happened below the surface.

items.name: Clover
items.oneLiner: Spots an overlooked possibility without calling it destiny.
items.bio: A hopeful field researcher who enjoys the search as much as the find. Clover keeps a scrapbook of lucky encounters and the small choices that made them possible.

items.name: Layers
items.oneLiner: Helps a story reveal itself one careful layer at a time.
items.bio: The garden's oral historian is patient with complicated memories. Layers believes a good interview leaves the speaker feeling more understood than examined.

items.name: Patch
items.oneLiner: Turns leftovers into the beginning of a gathering.
items.bio: A seasonal festival maker who can turn an empty lot into a welcome. Patch is planning a harvest parade for things that took longer than expected.

items.name: Pack
items.oneLiner: Keeps the essentials light enough for a spontaneous detour.
items.bio: The field club's packing enthusiast always leaves room for something found along the way. Pack is assembling a travel kit for exploring your own postcode.

items.name: Lane
items.oneLiner: Shows how the familiar route can lead to a new idea.
items.bio: A street-level cartographer who draws landmarks by the stories attached to them. Lane's maps always include the best place to stop and do nothing.

items.name: Meter
items.oneLiner: Turns the ride across town into part of the adventure.
items.bio: A conversational city guide who knows which corner has the nicest evening light. Meter is recording an audio tour made entirely of passengers' favourite local memories.

items.name: Glide
items.oneLiner: Helps an ambitious plan make a gentle landing.
items.bio: The club's route coordinator thinks arrival should feel like a welcome. Glide loves small destinations with very large windows.

items.name: Isla
items.oneLiner: Finds a pocket of quiet inside the busy world.
items.bio: A neighborhood escape artist whose journeys rarely take more than an hour. Isla is cataloguing the places where the city briefly sounds like somewhere else.

items.name: Summit
items.oneLiner: Makes the next small step feel worth taking.
items.bio: A hill-walking companion who never races the slowest member of the group. Summit's favourite view is the one everybody reaches together.

items.name: Igloo
items.oneLiner: Turns a temporary stop into a place to feel at home.
items.bio: The club's shelter designer is fascinated by clever, cozy spaces. Igloo is building a traveling reading room from things that fold flat.

items.name: Flurry
items.oneLiner: Preserves the feeling of a place without freezing its story.
items.bio: A souvenir curator who prefers a handwritten note to a famous landmark. Flurry keeps a collection of ordinary days that deserved a little snow-globe magic.

items.name: Dune
items.oneLiner: Builds something beautiful knowing it will change.
items.bio: A beach architect who treats the tide as a collaborator. Dune's workshops end with everyone choosing one detail to remember after the sculpture is gone.

items.name: Miles
items.oneLiner: Finds the good stop between the start and the destination.
items.bio: A road-trip narrator with an enthusiasm for overlooked roadside places. Miles is making a guidebook where every chapter ends before the journey does.

items.name: Branch
items.oneLiner: Makes a neighborhood promise easier to understand.
items.bio: The paper city's archivist keeps records of shared projects and small acts of trust. Branch is designing a ledger that gives generosity more space than arithmetic.

items.name: Mint
items.oneLiner: Gives an ordinary object the dignity of a keepsake.
items.bio: A collector of stories attached to coins, tokens and found buttons. Mint designs commemoratives for milestones too small for an official monument.

items.name: Penny
items.oneLiner: Shows how small contributions can become a shared project.
items.bio: A playful savings-club host who counts participation before totals. Penny's newest collection celebrates all the things friends can build without buying anything.

items.name: Foldsworth
items.oneLiner: Keeps a little room for the memory tucked beside the receipt.
items.bio: A wallet historian fascinated by the unofficial archives people carry. Foldsworth is curating an exhibition of ticket stubs whose owners still remember the whole night.

items.name: Safe
items.oneLiner: Looks after what matters and lets its owner set the rules.
items.bio: The archive's careful custodian thinks security begins with listening. Safe is creating a keepsake box where the label explains why the contents matter.

items.name: Treasure
items.oneLiner: Finds a collection's real value in the stories around it.
items.bio: A flea-market explorer who prefers the well-loved object to the flawless one. Treasure hosts show-and-tell evenings where nothing is priced and everything gets a story.

items.name: Post
items.oneLiner: Connects two people with a small piece of paper.
items.bio: The city's correspondence host supplies stamps, prompts and an unhurried table. Post believes writing to someone can make both places feel a little closer.

items.name: Clip
items.oneLiner: Keeps related ideas together without making them permanent.
items.bio: A flexible organizer who loves a draft more than a locked file. Clip is designing a noticeboard that changes whenever the neighborhood has something new to say.

items.name: Staple
items.oneLiner: Makes a small publication sturdy enough to pass around.
items.bio: The zine club's dependable finisher has a drawer full of handmade editions. Staple knows a story becomes different once someone can carry it home.

items.name: Graphite
items.oneLiner: Gives the first rough idea permission to exist.
items.bio: A drawing companion who keeps the eraser nearby but rarely reaches for it. Graphite hosts a sketch club where unfinished pages are welcome on the wall.

items.name: Seam
items.oneLiner: Finds the thread connecting every player on the field.
items.bio: The league's scorekeeper records assists, jokes and borrowed gloves alongside runs. Seam is making a season book in which everyone gets a page.

items.name: Bounce
items.oneLiner: Brings a little rhythm back after a missed shot.
items.bio: A pickup-game host who treats a dropped ball as the start of the next play. Bounce is designing a court with room for spectators who decide to join in.

items.name: Puck
items.oneLiner: Keeps a fast-moving group focused on the next good pass.
items.bio: The league's tactical doodler loves a beautifully simple plan. Puck's proudest victory was a practice where the newest player called the final move.

items.name: Kickflip
items.oneLiner: Turns an ordinary patch of ground into a playground.
items.bio: A street-skating storyteller who documents tiny first successes. Kickflip keeps the camera rolling for the laughter after the landing.

items.name: Volley
items.oneLiner: Makes the conversation keep moving across the net.
items.bio: A beach-game organizer who knows how to rotate people into the circle. Volley's special skill is turning strangers into teammates before anyone notices.

items.name: Curl
items.oneLiner: Shows how a small adjustment can change the whole path.
items.bio: The club's precision enthusiast pairs careful observation with gentle humor. Curl is devising a tabletop game for the rainy afternoons between matches.

items.name: Spar
items.oneLiner: Helps a friend practice being brave without needing an opponent.
items.bio: A patient movement coach who makes warm-ups feel like play. Spar's favourite exercise is learning how to stop, breathe and begin again.

items.name: Lift
items.oneLiner: Celebrates the effort that nobody else can see.
items.bio: The league's encouraging training partner keeps goals personal and progress visible. Lift is collecting stories about things people once thought they could never carry.

items.name: Sled
items.oneLiner: Makes a shared journey feel like a small expedition.
items.bio: A winter-play designer who can invent a game for almost any weather. Sled is planning a summer obstacle course inspired by the best parts of a snow day.

items.name: Grin
items.oneLiner: Reminds the team why they wanted to play in the first place.
items.bio: The league's unofficial mascot is also its most thoughtful listener. Grin's end-of-season award goes to the moment everyone laughed at once.
